# Market quality surveys

Independent and industry testing of retail omega-3 products. Results are
not directly comparable across studies because sampling frames, assays and
product mixes differ; the pattern matters more than any single number.

| ID | Study | Market | Year | N | Parameter | Result | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | ---: | --- | ---: | --- |
| SQ-01 | Albert et al., Sci Rep | New Zealand | 2014 | 32 | TOTOX exceedance | 50% | 18 of 36 in the full sample; 83% exceeded peroxide value; only 3 of 32 met labelled EPA+DHA |
| SQ-02 | Albert et al., Sci Rep | New Zealand | 2014 | 32 | Peroxide value exceedance | 83% | 25% exceeded p-anisidine; only 8% met all three oxidation limits |
| SQ-03 | Bannenberg et al., Nutrients | Australia and New Zealand | 2016 | 10 | TOTOX exceedance | 0% | All 10 met peroxide value; EPA+DHA averaged 109% of label |
| SQ-04 | Jackowski et al., J Nutr Sci | Canada | 2013 | 171 | Any oxidation marker exceedance | 50% | 39% exceeded TOTOX; unflavoured softgels outperformed bulk and flavoured oils |
| SQ-05 | Bannenberg et al., J Food Compos Anal | United States | 2018 | 48 | TOTOX exceedance (unflavoured) | 13% | Mean TOTOX 19.2; 87% of unflavoured products complied |
